'''0.20c''' is a minor update for [[Survarium]] that fixed a bug that improved player identification in the HUD and adjusted various stats and UI elements.

==Changelog==
* Biker helmet is now only available for the elite [[Black Market]]
* The game no longer gives unranked players a job to search for an artifact
* Changed the display of minimap so that allies should be more visible
* Changed the visual style of player indicators. Snipers displayed with triangles, stormtroopers with squares, etc.

* Increased font size for combat chat
* Increased font size for combat log
* Increased size of the icons of items in battle
* Increased the size of the mini-map
* Slightly repositioned chat combat log and quick access items in battle

* Reduced the value of all weapons in the game by 2-4 times
* Reduced sound dispersion of machine gun pistol
* Increased buckshot damage, reduced damage of buckshot with distance
* Increased armour of the vest for [[Renaissance Army]]
* Reduced ammunition effect when hit

===Bug fixes===
* Accelerated the procedure of loading character when connecting to the lobby server
* Fixed bug with hanging lobby
* Fixed out of sync error in the calculation of recoil
* Optimization of server lobby
* Fixed bug in the mechanism of match selection
* Fixed display of character model damage
* Fixed some text
* Fixed hanging in the lobby with a large quantity of messages in game chat
